result.reason: The redline gives Licensee the preferred affiliate/M&A assignment carve-outs and removes Licensor's change-of-control termination right, but it does not regulate Licensor assignments at all. It therefore reaches neither the preferred position (Customer consent for Vendor assignments and an absolute competitor prohibition) nor the fallback (mutual successor assignment rights with notice and reasonable consent for other assignments). It also unnecessarily adds suspension and repricing restrictions beyond the stated rule. Drafting is ambiguous because the following sentence still declares any assignment or transfer without consent void, without expressly excluding the newly permitted assignments, and the inherited missing punctuation before “Subject to the terms” remains. The separate right of first refusal and other unrelated commercial terms are preserved.
